labs.title: Lab 8 — Pattern set

labs.title: Lab 9 — Modular calculator

labs.title: Lab 10 — Recursion set
labs.brief: factorial, sum aur fibonacci recursion se print karo.
labs.objective: Recursion ka base case, call stack aur recursive vs iterative trade-off samajhna.

labs.title: Lab 11 — Array statistics
labs.brief: 5 numbers input lo aur sum, min, max, average print karo.
labs.objective: 1D/2D arrays, initialization, traversal, search/sort aur memory layout samajhna.
labs.solution:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){int a[5],s=0,lo,hi;for(int i=0;i<5;i++)scanf("%d",&a[i]);lo=hi=a[0];for(int i=0;i<5;i++){s+=a[i];if(a[i]<lo)lo=a[i];if(a[i]>hi)hi=a[i];}printf("sum=%d min=%d max=%d avg=%.2f\n",s,lo,hi,s/5.0);return 0;}

labs.brief: String input lo aur length, vowels aur palindrome status print karo.
labs.objective: Character arrays, null terminator aur string library ko safely use karna.

labs.title: Lab 13 — Pointer explorer
labs.brief: x ka address aur value print karo, pointer se value badlo, aur array ko pointer se traverse karo.
labs.objective: Address, dereference, NULL, pointer arithmetic, const variants aur segfault ko memory maps ke saath samajhna.

labs.title: Lab 15 — Student database
labs.brief: 3 students ka array banao, average marks aur topper print karo.

labs.title: Lab 16 — Safe dynamic array

labs.title: Lab 17 — Notes file
labs.brief: Do lines file me likho, phir file padh kar print karo.
labs.objective: fopen modes, formatted aur binary I/O, seek aur error handling se persistent data likhna.
labs.solution:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){FILE *f=fopen("/tmp/notes.txt","w");if(!f)return 1;fprintf(f,"line1\nline2\n");fclose(f);f=fopen("/tmp/notes.txt","r");if(!f)return 1;char b[64];while(fgets(b,sizeof b,f))printf("%s",b);fclose(f);return 0;}

labs.title: Lab 19 — Sort + search
labs.brief: Array input lo, sort karo aur ek key binary search se dhundo.
labs.objective: Complexity, linear/binary search, bubble/selection/insertion/merge/quick sort aur two-pointer patterns.

labs.title: Lab 20 — Stack implementation
labs.brief: Array-based stack banao: push, pop aur peek; output print karo.
labs.objective: Linked lists, stack, queue, BST, hash table aur BFS/DFS ko C me implement karna.
labs.solution:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){int a[8],top=-1;for(int i=1;i<=3;i++)a[++top]=i*10;printf("peek=%d\n",a[top]);while(top>=0)printf("%d ",a[top--]);printf("\n");return 0;}

labs.title: Hash-ish frequency
labs.brief: Array me element frequency count karo.
labs.objective: counting pattern
labs.solution:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){int a[]={2,3,2},n=3;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int c=0,seen=0;for(int k=0;k<i;k++)if(a[k]==a[i])seen=1;if(seen)continue;for(int j=0;j<n;j++)if(a[j]==a[i])c++;printf("%d:%d ",a[i],c);}printf("\n");return 0;}
